question: Which divine epithets are saluted in this hymn?
premises: narāya means to leader of men
karṇikāramahāsragviṇe means to wearer of great karṇikāra garland
inference: The deity is praised as leader of men and garland-wearer.
plain_english: Obeisance to the leader of men and the wearer of the great karṇikāra garland.
